description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ArrayEnabled' that provides methods for processing array arguments in spreadsheet calculations. It includes helper initializations, argument evaluation methods for different use cases (single, multiple, subsets, ignore), and references to classes handling argument processing.

methods.name: initialiseHelper
methods.description: Initializes the array argument helper with the provided arguments, creating an instance if needed.

methods.name: evaluateSingleArgumentArray
methods.description: Processes a single-argument function where the argument can be an array, applying the provided method to each value.

methods.name: evaluateArrayArguments
methods.description: Handles processing for functions accepting multiple arguments with potential array inputs, applying the method accordingly.

methods.name: evaluateArrayArgumentsSubset
methods.description: Processes functions where only the first 'limit' arguments can be arrays, combining trailing arguments appropriately.

methods.name: testFalse
methods.description: Checks if a value strictly equals false, used internally for validation.

methods.name: evaluateArrayArgumentsSubsetFrom
methods.description: Handles functions where only arguments from a start index can be arrays, applying processing accordingly.

methods.name: evaluateArrayArgumentsIgnore
methods.description: Processes functions where one argument (specified by 'ignore') is excluded from array processing, merging arguments accordingly.
